# The Exchange header-array assertions lack diagnostic messages

The selected change adds five C++ assertions for aligned message keys, raw headers and filter targets without expected-behavior messages. The inspected accepted queue and target checks still have no message. These checks should name the arrays whose lengths must agree, so a failure states the required invariant. This is a diagnostic source finding, not an observed mismatch. The runtime ApplyFilters input check is a separate guard; historical acceptance does not make missing messages a style exception.

Scope: Exchange filter array invariants and assertion diagnostics.
